title: Finite local presentation transported to the source stalk
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $\mathcal F$ a finitely presented module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation] and $x\in X$. With $R=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and $\mathcal F_x$ the module stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], [def-pc-module-stalk-functor], there exist an open $U\ni x$, $m,n\geq0$, sections $s_i\in\mathcal F(U)$, and $R$-linear maps $a:R^m\to R^n$ and $b:R^n\to\mathcal F_x$ such that $b$ is surjective, $\operatorname{Im}(a)=\operatorname{Ker}(b)$, and $b(e_i)=(s_i)_x$ for every $i<n$.

source.place: Tag 01CP, proof, third paragraph: the right exact source-stalk presentation; Definition 01BN.

proof.text: Choose quasicoherentData from IsFinitePresentation. Its coversTop property gives an open neighborhood containing x with a supplied finite Presentation. Apply the local-presentation stalk theorem.
Apply Mathlib Module.FinitePresentation.exists_fin' to obtain finite free linear maps a,b, with b surjective and a,b exact.

Represent each of the finitely many basis images b(e_i) by a section germ. Induct on n, using top for n=0 and intersecting the previous neighborhood with a representative neighborhood in the successor step. Restrict sections to the intersection and use germ_res_apply. Reverse the resulting germ equalities to give the stated generator formula.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01CP third paragraph; Q2 algebraic factorization through Module.FinitePresentation.exists_fin', with a proved finite common-neighborhood construction.

lean.statement: theorem exists_finitePresentation_source_stalk (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf)) [SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation.{u} F] (x : X) : ∃ (U : Opens X) (hxU : x ∈ U) (m n : ℕ) (s : Fin n → F.val.obj (op U)) (a : (Fin m → X.presheaf.stalk x) →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x] (Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk x)) (b : (Fin n → X.presheaf.stalk x) →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x] (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj F), Function.Surjective b ∧ Function.Exact a b ∧ (∀ i, b (Pi.single i 1) = TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U x hxU (s i))
